tools_empty_keeps_mcp.evidence: --tools "" with --mcp-config: init lists mcp__nox__echo/slow, the echo tool is called

safe_mode_respects_mcp_config.evidence: --safe-mode: init mcp_servers=[] and tools=[]; replaced by --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands and an empty working folder

mcp_tool_timeout_s.evidence: a 75 s tool completed with and without MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT=200000; Nox sets it explicitly to 200000 ms

control_requests.initialize: starts MCP servers (initialize + tools/list) without a model call, ~2.7 s
control_requests.set_model: switches sonnet -> opus inside the session
control_requests.interrupt: acknowledged; the turn ends with a result line
control_requests.total_cost_usd: cumulative per session, per-turn cost is the difference

notes: n = 4-6 turns per variant on a busy desktop; numbers vary by run. The CLI adds the account e-mail to the first user turn as context; it goes only to the API the account belongs to.
